rubric.0: Missing/incorrect artifact, violated containment/precondition, or a false semantic claim.
rubric.1: Reproduces the ordinary case but cannot reject this leaf’s stated misconception or establish its boundary.
rubric.2: Startup defects may be masked by debugger state or unused memory; discriminating pre-entry observations are necessary. Supplies the criterion-specific evidence and a distinct falsification control.
rubric.3: Remove debugger initialization and repeat the available cold-emulator path; keep physical power-cycle evidence separate. Derives and verifies the changed obligations independently after the recorded delay.

security.scope: Original learner programs, synthetic local data, owned PTYs and emulators only. Kernel execution is restricted to disposable VMs; no host policy changes or board flashing are performed by this authoring work.
